corpus.note: SHA copied verbatim from corpora/manifest.json, the sole pin authority. Largest of the eight locally indexed corpora at file-rollup scale: 3,233 file-level nodes and 21,554 distinct file-pair edges after D-03's contains/self-edge exclusion and D-08's package-pseudo-node exclusion. apache/arrow is not a candidate — corpora/selection.json records it rejected before measurement. Already fully indexed on this machine under ~/.cache/codegraph/corpora/ at the directory named for this SHA.

bindingView: The EXPANDED file level: every file node rendered, grouped inside directory compound parents — the default first paint GRF-02 describes. This is the harder bar and is what binds. The collapsed directory-level view guava also yields (about 134 top-level compound nodes and 819 directory-pair edges) is measured and recorded in recordedNonBinding.collapsedView but is explicitly NOT the binding number — a collapsed view would pass by construction on any renderer and make GRF-01 a formality, which D-02 forbids.
